United States of America

Great Destination for Business and Study

Study. Work. Invest in the USA

Written by Al Anfal Doc Team·Last updated 5 November 2026

Quick answer

The United States offers visitor, student and business visa categories, each with its own requirements and an interview process run by US authorities. A professional service can help assemble accurate, properly attested documentation, but it cannot influence the decision.

Key takeaways

  • Visitor, student and business visas are the most common categories
  • Interviews and decisions are handled by US authorities
  • Accurate, attested documents are essential
  • Allow time for attestation before your appointment
